{
  "obligations": [
    {
      "text": "The Internal Ombudsman (IO) must be a retired or serving officer of rank equivalent to General Manager in the Reserve Bank or a Financial Sector Regulatory Body and must have at least seven years of relevant experience.",
      "actor": "Bank (appointing authority)",
      "action": "appoint an IO with specified rank and experience",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "5",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "If the IO is a serving officer, he/she must relinquish the serving position before assuming charge as IO.",
      "actor": "IO (serving officer)",
      "action": "relinquish current serving position",
      "condition": "when appointed as IO while still serving",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "5",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "The IO must not have been employed nor be presently employed by the bank or any of its holding, associate or subsidiary companies.",
      "actor": "Bank (appointing authority)",
      "action": "ensure the IO has no prior or current employment with the bank or its group",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "5",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "The IO must not be over 70 years of age before the completion of the tenure.",
      "actor": "Bank (appointing authority)",
      "action": "verify age limit for IO",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "5",
      "severity": "low"
    },
    {
      "text": "Every bank shall appoint at least one Internal Ombudsman.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "appoint at least one IO",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "7",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The Customer Service Committee of the Board shall determine, at least once a year, the number of IO/Deputy IO to be appointed, considering complaint volume and complexity.",
      "actor": "Customer Service Committee of the Board",
      "action": "determine annual number of IO/DyIO positions",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "at least once a year",
      "source_ref": "7",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "When appointing additional IO/Deputy IO, the bank shall consider the need for diversity of experience among incumbents.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "consider diversity of experience",
      "condition": "while appointing additional IO/DyIO",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "7",
      "severity": "low"
    },
    {
      "text": "The appointment of the IO/Deputy IO shall be on a contractual basis.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "make IO/DyIO appointments contractual",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "8",
      "severity": "low"
    },
    {
      "text": "The bank shall ensure that the post of the IO does not remain vacant at any point in time.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "keep the IO position continuously filled",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "8",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The tenure of the IO/Deputy IO shall be a fixed term of not less than three years and the total tenure (including extensions) shall not exceed five years.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "set IO/DyIO tenure between 3 and 5 years",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "8",
      "severity": "medium"
    },
    {
      "text": "To fill a vacancy, the bank shall undertake the process of fresh appointment at least three months before the expiry of the incumbent IO’s tenure and ensure a reasonable overlap between the outgoing and incoming IO.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "initiate fresh appointment process",
      "condition": "when a vacancy is anticipated",
      "deadline": "at least three months before expiry; ensure overlap",
      "source_ref": "8",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The IO/Deputy IO shall not be removed before the completion of the contracted term without the approval of the Customer Service Committee of the Board.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "obtain Committee approval before early removal",
      "condition": "if removal is contemplated before term ends",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "8",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "If a vacancy arises due to resignation, incapacitation, illness, death or other reasons beyond the bank’s control, the bank shall inform the Reserve Bank of India within 10 working days and appoint a new IO/Deputy IO within three months of the vacancy.",
      "actor": "Bank",
      "action": "notify RBI and appoint replacement",
      "condition": "when vacancy occurs for reasons beyond bank’s control",
      "deadline": "inform RBI within 10 working days; appoint within three months",
      "source_ref": "8",
      "severity": "high"
    },
    {
      "text": "The Customer Service Committee of the Board shall determine the structure of emoluments, facilities and benefits for the IO/Deputy IO and shall not change them adversely during the tenure.",
      "actor": "Customer Service Committee of the Board",
      "action": "determine and maintain emoluments, facilities and benefits",
      "condition": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "source_ref": "8",
      "severity": "medium"
    }
  ]
}
